Manual check: enable Ceox on a Dialog via Cast Header, ask Kip 'Ceox, you here?', confirm Kip's reply no longer claims Ceox is absent from the team (note: this does not mean Ceox actually responds as a distinct voice -- that's real delegation, Phase 2, separate and still out of scope; this handoff only fixes Kip's own awareness/roster-listing)

context.notes: Root cause confirmed by direct code read, not guessed: the literal strings 'Agent Availability' / 'not currently part of' / 'active agent team' do not exist anywhere in the codebase as hardcoded copy -- Kip is an LLM free-forming that sentence because its own system prompt's roster block (built from environment.domainAgents) genuinely does not list Ceox, and the prompt explicitly instructs it: 'Do not claim domain agents are absent when they appear in this list' (agents.ts ~line 3920). Kip is doing exactly what it's told; the list it's given is just stale relative to what DialogCastMember and the UI already know. This is deliberately sequenced last of the three because it's the most surgical/isolated of the three fixes and least urgent (a wrong sentence from Kip, not data pollution or a missing panel) -- but it's the one that would make today's Phase 1 (cross-domain-cast-membership) actually feel complete to Chuck rather than half-working.
